options.effect: { ywc_nqg_winter_close_as_established = yes  if = { limit = { has_variable = ywc_nqg_winter_deferred_event has_variable = ywc_nqg_winter_stage var:ywc_nqg_winter_stage > var:ywc_nqg_winter_deferred_event } ywc_nqg_winter_clear_deferred_obligation = yes } }
options.trigger: { has_variable = ywc_v03_nqg_v03_nqg_winter_court_started NOT = { has_variable = ywc_v03_nqg_v03_nqg_winter_court_settled } NOT = { has_variable = ywc_nqg_winter_any_outcome } NOT = { has_variable = ywc_nqg_winter_notice12_pending } NOT = { has_variable = ywc_nqg_winter_notice36_pending } NOT = { has_variable = ywc_nqg_winter_notice12_intent } NOT = { has_variable = ywc_nqg_winter_notice36_intent } NOT = { has_variable = ywc_nqg_winter_notice12_open } NOT = { has_variable = ywc_nqg_winter_notice36_open } ywc_nqg_winter_full_ready = yes }

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用；要求三处决定齐备且连续六个月达标。
cost_note.en: No new cost; requires all three decisions and six continuous months in place.

consequence_note.zh: 分摊成为常例，宗室与地方的义务写进册子。
consequence_note.en: The apportionment becomes standing and obligations are written into the register.

label.en: Carry It One More Year As Is

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_winter_close_as_compromise = yes  if = { limit = { has_variable = ywc_nqg_winter_deferred_event has_variable = ywc_nqg_winter_stage var:ywc_nqg_winter_stage > var:ywc_nqg_winter_deferred_event } ywc_nqg_winter_clear_deferred_obligation = yes } }
options.trigger: { has_variable = ywc_v03_nqg_v03_nqg_winter_court_started NOT = { has_variable = ywc_v03_nqg_v03_nqg_winter_court_settled } NOT = { has_variable = ywc_nqg_winter_any_outcome } NOT = { has_variable = ywc_nqg_winter_notice12_pending } NOT = { has_variable = ywc_nqg_winter_notice36_pending } NOT = { has_variable = ywc_nqg_winter_notice12_intent } NOT = { has_variable = ywc_nqg_winter_notice36_intent } NOT = { has_variable = ywc_nqg_winter_notice12_open } NOT = { has_variable = ywc_nqg_winter_notice36_open } ywc_nqg_winter_compromise_ready = yes }

cost_note.zh: 不新增费用。
cost_note.en: No new cost.

consequence_note.zh: 粮政勉强成立，但没有解决分摊口径。
consequence_note.en: The policy barely holds, but the apportionment standard stays unresolved.

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_winter_close_as_breach = yes }

cost_note.zh: 已付的费用与已签的约定不退还。
cost_note.en: Fees already paid and terms already signed are not refunded.

consequence_note.zh: 这条线记为受挫，名额释放；旧账仍然有效。
consequence_note.en: The line is recorded as frustrated and the slot frees up; old debts stand.

label.zh: 确认收到一年期补救通知

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_winter_acknowledge_12 = yes  if = { limit = { has_variable = ywc_nqg_winter_deferred_event has_variable = ywc_nqg_winter_stage var:ywc_nqg_winter_stage > var:ywc_nqg_winter_deferred_event } ywc_nqg_winter_clear_deferred_obligation = yes } }

cost_note.zh: 不需追加费用；保留已付成本。
cost_note.en: No new fee; prior costs remain sunk.

consequence_note.zh: 承认原安排仍未达标，保留普通待办并等待三年补救通知。
consequence_note.en: The arrangement remains unqualified; normal work stays queued while the 36-month remedy remains due.

label.zh: 三年补救无可行条件，退出本案

options.effect: { remove_variable = ywc_nqg_winter_notice36_open remove_variable = ywc_nqg_winter_notice36_intent set_variable = { name = ywc_nqg_winter_blocked_36_delivered value = 1 } ywc_nqg_winter_close_as_breach = yes  if = { limit = { has_variable = ywc_nqg_winter_deferred_event has_variable = ywc_nqg_winter_stage var:ywc_nqg_winter_stage > var:ywc_nqg_winter_deferred_event } ywc_nqg_winter_clear_deferred_obligation = yes } }

cost_note.zh: 不追加费用；本案已付成本不退。
cost_note.en: No additional fee; prior costs are not refunded.

consequence_note.zh: 结束无法履行的本案并释放名额。
consequence_note.en: End the unworkable arrangement and release its slot.

label.zh: 以较低目标重启六个月观察
label.en: Begin a Fresh Six-Month Watch for the Lower Target

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_winter_begin_limited_watch = yes  if = { limit = { has_variable = ywc_nqg_winter_deferred_event has_variable = ywc_nqg_winter_stage var:ywc_nqg_winter_stage > var:ywc_nqg_winter_deferred_event } ywc_nqg_winter_clear_deferred_obligation = yes } }
options.trigger: { has_variable = ywc_v03_nqg_v03_nqg_winter_court_started NOT = { has_variable = ywc_v03_nqg_v03_nqg_winter_court_settled } has_variable = ywc_nqg_winter_notice36_open has_variable = ywc_nqg_winter_fee_paid ywc_nqg_winter_narrow_ready = yes }

cost_note.zh: 不追加费用，已付费用不退。
cost_note.en: No new fee; prior costs remain sunk.

consequence_note.zh: 仅在当前较低方案条件成立时重启全新的180日观察；不会自动完成。
consequence_note.en: If the lower target qualifies now, begin a new 180-day watch. It does not settle automatically.

purpose.zh: 过冬的结论不是「熬过去了」，而是「明年还照这套做吗」。
purpose.en: Surviving is not the conclusion; the conclusion is whether next year repeats this.

desc.zh: 受邀朝廷收到北清按当期仓底拟定的粮援询请：偿还总额按申请时的年收入折算，分三次月付，粮食须真实运入北清。只有实际受邀国家可以接受或拒绝；陈旧回函不改变任何条款。
desc.en: The invited court receives Northern Qing’s aid inquiry: the repayment total is fixed from the income recorded at admission, paid in three monthly installments, and grain must actually move to Northern Qing. Only the actual recipient may accept or refuse; a stale answer changes no terms.

label.en: Grant Grain on the Captured Terms

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_aid_authorize_accept = yes }

cost_note.zh: 出粮方在本项不收款；接受后由北清按捕获总额分三次月付。
cost_note.en: The provider collects nothing here; after acceptance Northern Qing pays the captured total in three monthly installments.

consequence_note.zh: 答复固定本次代际与总额；北清仍须先有真实粮食流向才能签约。
consequence_note.en: The answer fixes this generation and total; Northern Qing must still show an actual grain flow before signing.

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_aid_refuse = yes }

cost_note.zh: 双方国库都不扣款。
cost_note.en: Neither treasury is charged.

consequence_note.zh: 北清收到拒绝，可改走国内限额供养路线；已付立案费不退。
consequence_note.en: Northern Qing receives the refusal and may take the domestic stipend-cap route; the filing fee already paid is not refunded.

cost_note.zh: 没有付款。
cost_note.en: No payment.

consequence_note.zh: 失效询请不能改写后续的粮援条款。
consequence_note.en: A stale inquiry cannot rewrite a later aid offer.

purpose.zh: 让出粮方按真实仓底与关系自主答复，固定对象、代际和总额。
purpose.en: Let the provider answer from its own granary and relations while fixing participants, generation and total.

desc.zh: 粮援的状态由北清自行处理：询请、已接受的条款、拒绝、过期、对方失效，或已生效合同的三次月付与欠款。签约定量必须有真实粮食流向；已开付的欠款不因改走国内路线而消失。
desc.en: Northern Qing handles the aid’s status locally: inquiry, accepted terms, refusal, expiry, a lost partner, or an active contract’s three installments and arrears. Signing requires an actual grain flow; earned debt survives a domestic alternative.

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_aid_choose_sign = yes }

cost_note.zh: 签约不收款；此后三次月度点验各按捕获总额三分之一实付。
cost_note.en: Signature collects nothing; each of three monthly inspections pays one third of the captured total.

consequence_note.zh: 只认签约时封存的出粮州与市场对象；货源变化须重新询请。
consequence_note.en: Only the grain district and markets captured at signature count; a changed source needs a new inquiry.

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_aid_choose_decline = yes }

cost_note.zh: 此项不收费。
cost_note.en: This choice charges nothing.

consequence_note.zh: 未签询请作废；已开付的欠款仍然存在。
consequence_note.en: Unsigned work ends; earned arrears remain.

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_aid_choose_wait = yes }

cost_note.zh: 等待免费。
cost_note.en: Waiting is free.

consequence_note.zh: 三个月询请期不因重看刷新；到期自动作废。
consequence_note.en: The three-month inquiry lifetime is not refreshed by redisplay; it lapses on schedule.

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_aid_choose_status = yes }

cost_note.zh: 此项不收费。
cost_note.en: This choice charges nothing.

consequence_note.zh: 保留现有欠款和月付窗口。
consequence_note.en: Existing arrears and the monthly window remain.

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_aid_choose_domestic = yes }

cost_note.zh: 此项不收费；国内路线费用按原事件执行。
cost_note.en: This choice charges nothing; the domestic route keeps its existing costs.

consequence_note.zh: 未签外部询请作废；已签合同的欠款继续有效。
consequence_note.en: Unsigned foreign work ends; signed contract debt remains payable.

options.effect: { ywc_nqg_aid_choose_retry_shu = yes }

cost_note.zh: 新询请不扣款；旧约须结清且窗口结束。
cost_note.en: A new inquiry charges nothing; the previous balance must be settled and its window ended.

consequence_note.zh: 新询请采用新代际；旧回函与旧条款不得再签约。
consequence_note.en: The retry has a new generation; old answers and terms cannot sign it.

consequence_note.en: The retry has a new generation; old answers and terms cannot sign it.

cost_note.zh: 没有付款。
cost_note.en: No payment.

consequence_note.zh: 失效通知不影响当前条款、债务或事件队列。
consequence_note.en: The stale notice leaves the current terms, debt and queues intact.

purpose.zh: 为回函、拒答、过期、失效与恢复提供本地粮援路线。
purpose.en: Give replies, refusals, expiry, loss and recovery a local aid path.

desc.zh: 固定的三次月付窗口届满，只清除该代的窗口标记；已计欠款与已付记录不受影响。
desc.en: The fixed three-month repayment window ends and only its own term marker is cleared; earned debt and paid records are untouched.

purpose.en: End the matching repayment generation independently without touching debt, queues or the winter arc.

desc.en: Where the enclosure deed overlaps older community boundaries, settle whose line counts before cutting and grazing.
